summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp completed the acquisition of WNG II Aircraft Leasing (Cayman) Ltd. and WNG Aircraft Management 3, LLC from WNG International Master Fund II and WNG II Aircraft Management, acquiring a portfolio of twelve commercial aircraft and thirteen spare engines. The base purchase price was $379.3 million, adjusted for rents, reserves, and other items, with a 6.25% interest adjustment. The deal closed August 24, 2026. Watch for integration of the portfolio and potential fleet financing updates.
